title: Soil Preparation for Crop Production Processes Explained
reason: Explains the importance of soil preparation for agricultural practices.

tasks.task: Describe the process of soil preparation in agriculture.

subtasks.text: Explain why soil needs to be loosened before cultivation.
Mention the role of earthworms in soil aeration.
Describe how loosening soil helps retain water.
Explain the process of decomposition and how it forms humus.
Describe the benefit of loosening soil for plant nutrient uptake.

tasks.task: Describe the equipment used for soil preparation in agriculture.

subtasks.text: Mention the plough and its role in loosening soil.
Explain why it might be necessary to water the soil before plowing if it is hard.
Describe the process of breaking down chunks of soil after plowing.
Explain how soil needs to be leveled for seed sowing.
Mention the use of manure to improve soil fertility.
